fixtures.preview: Mauricio Pochettino, appointed on 13 Nov and due to start on Wed 18 Nov, is set to take charge at Anfield (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) after only three training days.
talking_points: Pochettino replaces the sacked Michael Carrick on a deal to summer 2029; Sky Sports News understands United must pay about £7.4m to free him from the USA job.
United are 18th with 8 points from 10 (one win, five draws, four losses), their worst-ever Premier League start, per Sky's table of 8 Nov.
Liverpool were 4th on 18 points as of 8 Nov, and sit 8th in the Champions League table on 9 points; United are 17th on 6.
Line-ups and injuries aren't confirmed, so it's unclear who Pochettino can pick.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), with United 17th on 6 points and Sporting 10th on 9 after four games.
Brentford (8th, 14 points as of 8 Nov) visit Old Trafford at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), probably Pochettino's home debut.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney) against a 12th-placed side on 12 points as of 8 Nov; the schedule is subject to change.
Coventry, one place above United in 17th on 9 points as of 8 Nov, visit at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney) in a relegation-zone six-pointer.
Sydney go to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) off a 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored a hat-trick in the 4-1 win over the Mariners, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for the club.
Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
Sydney were 2nd on 7 points from 4 games and Brisbane 3rd on 7 from 3 as of 8 Nov (Wikipedia ladder, not re-checked).
The squad for Brisbane isn't named yet, and no injury list has been published.

fixtures.preview: The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.
A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm New Zealand time (3pm Sydney).
A Friday-night home game against Perth Glory at 7:40pm.
A Monday-night home game against Macarthur FC at 7pm.

notes: Man Utd appointed Mauricio Pochettino on 13 Nov (Sky Sports); he starts Wed 18 Nov and the Liverpool game is his first. League standings are from Sky's 8 Nov table and the Champions League table is from 4 Nov (NBC); neither was updated after the international break.

Sydney FC: kick-off times for all five fixtures match Fotmob's listings (UTC) and the A-Leagues fixture guide, but the A-Leagues match page still shows Brisbane as TBC. The ladder positions are from Wikipedia as of 8 Nov and weren't re-checked; no team news or injury list was found.

Big matches: the Jordan friendly has moved to Doha with no kick-off time (12:00 Doha time is a placeholder). Scotland v Wallabies (Wallabies lost 15-12) was removed as finished. ATP Finals (15–22 Nov) was left out because beIN's coverage couldn't be confirmed. Man Utd's and Sporting's broadcaster is listed as Stan Sport, which holds the Champions League and Nations Championship rights.

Local: nothing from the last 7 days in Redfern, Alexandria, Erskineville, Waterloo or Eveleigh except the e-bike story, and South Eveleigh's events page gave nothing for November. School dates come from the Term 4 calendars and Week 5 Principal Updates (dates may change). Nothing was found for the second school.

Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found in the window. Sydney Kings' next confirmed home game (Fri 25 Dec) is outside it. Sydney FC Women's venue comes from the club's ticket page.

Arts: gig details come from Sydney Music's guide, read only up to 21 Nov, so later gigs may be missing. Whispering Jack's dates and price come from search reports (the STC page blocked access). Hoodoo Gurus and Wolf Alice's Sydney dates and prices are from an earlier check; Frontier's tour list confirms their tour windows.

Son and daughter: nothing confirmed for Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events, a junior parkrun or Sydney author events. Sydney FC summer holiday clinics (ages 5–13) were announced without dates. A matcha class at Surry Hills ($55, per search results) couldn't be opened.
Family fun: Powerhouse, Hockney, Nolan, KOOZA, SIX, Wundr and DigiPark details come from Ella's List's weekend guide (page dates are for 7–15 Nov), so check each venue before booking.

Groceries: the OzBargain list for 11–17 Nov is the latest, so these specials end tomorrow, Tue 17 Nov. The 18–24 Nov Woolworths and Coles specials weren't published yet, and Aldi's page showed no prices, so Aldi is omitted. No half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs or wholegrain bread were listed.
Deals: Rebel, Nike, Adidas and EB Games Black Friday dates are only estimates from guides, so they aren't listed. Hungry Jack's and Guzman y Gomez deals expired on 15 Nov.
Horizon: Radiohead is new this run; the other entries are carried over and only lightly re-checked, as marked in their notes.
